verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR platform. In the evidence it acts as an MCP server that external AI clients (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) connect to, and as a CLI that agents drive. Nothing shows it acting as an MCP host that plugs in third-party servers. Consuming external MCP tools is an agent-host role outside a payroll platform's category, and server-side MCP evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
